izzyondroid:com.amnesica.kryptey.summary: Keyboard for secure E2EE communication through signal protocol in any messenger
izzyondroid:com.amnesica.kryptey.description:
Communicate securely and independent, regardless of the legal situation or whether messengers use E2EE. No server needed. #ChatKontrolleStoppen
 Why KryptEY? 
 Breaking of end-to-end encryption (E2EE) by laws such as the planned EU chat control is an ongoing issue. Content in messengers that use E2EE, such as Whatsapp or Signal, could thus be monitored by third parties. E2EE is often, but not always, standard in messengers. There are proven methods for E2EE such as PGP. However, these methods are sometimes cumbersomely integrated and require a lot of effort to use.
 KryptEY is an Android keyboard that implements the Signal protocol. The keyboard works messenger-independently and both the X3DH Key Agreement Protocol and the Double Ratchet Algorithm work without a server, thus it enables a highly independent use of the protocol.
 Features 
 Based upon the Simple Keyboard KryptEY adds a view above the Keyboard for the E2EE functionality.
 use E2EE through Signal Protocol in any messenger
 encryption/decryption of messages
 enter message through separate text field in keyboard
 use clipboard to read messages
 manage contacts in own contact list in keyboard
 message log to view sent/received messages
 send messages as plain JSON (raw mode) or hidden in a decoy text (fairytale mode)
 verification of E2EE functionality via fingerprint
 Q&A View for questions
 dark & light theme
 See this document for further information on how KryptEY is working.
 Security 
 The existing security properties for the Signal Protocol are also valid for the keyboard.
 Limitations 
 The keyboard was designed as a POC and only allows 1-to-1 conversations. However, the application can also be used in a group chat to a limited extent. Here, a message can be directed to a specific chat partner and not to all people. Other participants of the group chat cannot decrypt the message.
 Text messages in Telegram are getting copied as HTML and not as plain text. When decoding the message with the fairytale mode the copied message is compromised and can't be read properly. Therefore, it can't be decoded at all. However, the raw mode works properly. When using KryptEY with Telegram we recommend the raw mode.
 Some messengers like Threema only allows up to 3500 bytes per message. Therefore, different character input limitations apply. To stay under the 3500 bytes limit, only 500 characters are allowed for raw and fairytale mode. For convenience these limitation applies for all messengers.
 Demo 
 For a demonstration on how KryptEY is used see this link.

flathub:dev.boxi.Boxi.name: Boxi
flathub:dev.boxi.Boxi.description:
This is a thought-experiment app based around the idea of having a terminal emulator running in a separate container from the session inside of it, with the kernel as the only intermediary.
 This is accomplished by means of file descriptor passing of the pseudo-terminal device from a small "agent" program running on the other side of a container boundary. The agent is started using the usual container tools (flatpak-spawn, toolbox, podman), but creating a session is done purely via sockets.
 Boxi uses different application identifiers when it is run for different containers. This allows creating individual launcher icons for each container.

flathub:io.poez.Poezio.name: Poezio
flathub:io.poez.Poezio.summary: Poezio is a free console XMPP client
flathub:io.poez.Poezio.description:
Poezio is a free console XMPP client (the protocol on which the Jabber IM
 network is built).
 Its goal is to let you connect very easily (no account creation needed)
 to the network and join various chatrooms, immediately. It tries to look
 like the most famous IRC clients (weechat, irssi, etc). Many commands are
 identical and you won’t be lost if you already know these clients.
 Configuration can be made in a configuration file or directly from the
 client.
 You’ll find the light, fast, geeky and anonymous spirit of IRC while
 using a powerful, standard and open protocol.
 Features
 Encryption: TLS, OMEMO, always chat with encryption.
 Chatrooms: Discuss on your favorite topics with your friends or strangers.
 Carbon copies: Switch devices while staying in the same conversations without losing messages.
 Plugins: Add the features you want through official or other plugins.
 Corrections: Fix your last sent messages.
 Rich text: Send and receive messages with colors and formatting.
 Chat state notifications: See the writing status of your contacts.
 Anonymous: Use XMPP without an account.

flathub:net.peercoin.peercoin-qt.name: Peercoin
flathub:net.peercoin.peercoin-qt.summary: Peercoin, a green crypto for sustainable future.
flathub:net.peercoin.peercoin-qt.description:
Peercoin, launched in August 2012, is the world's first cryptocoin secured by Proof of Stake.
 It stands as an energy-efficient digital store of value, enabling online transactions without relying on a central authority.
 Its efficient design allows for transaction validation even on basic hardware like the first-generation Raspberry Pi.
 Owning Peercoins grants active participation in the proof-of-stake consensus, offering the opportunity to create new blocks and earn rewards, setting it apart from alternative cryptocurrencies.

firefox-addons:2730344.name: OK.ru Downloader (IDL Helper)
firefox-addons:2730344.summary: Download Odnoklassniki / Instagram videos and extract audio from video with just a few mouse clicks. Supported media formats are MP3, MP4, WEBM. Capture frames from online videos with a screenshot button.
firefox-addons:2730344.description:
OK.ru Downloader is a powerful Odnoklassniki downloader. In most cases, you can download a MP3 or MP4 file with one click, otherwise, please, follow the link to Instaloader website and use IDL Client software (Windows only). The extension also supports downloading from Instagram. You are able to extract music, thus IDL Helper is a powerful online video to MP3 converter: Instagram to MP3 converter, Odnoklassniki to MP3 converter. The extension can be used to take screenshots from online videos: it adds a screenshot button to the player. Most extension features are universal for any video service, but some features are service-specific. See details on IDL Helper. Odnoklassniki features are listed below. Download video:
  • in MP4 format with sound ( );
  • with normal and high frame rates (e.g. 60 fps);
  • in resolutions: 360p, 720p [HD], 1080p [Full HD], 1440p 2K [Ultra HD], 2160p 4K [Ultra HD], 4320p 8K [Ultra HD].
Download audio (from video):
  • in MP4 and MP3 ( *) formats;
  • at the highest possible bitrate.
The PLAYER format may appear on some sites. This is an EXPERIMENTAL feature to download videos directly from the site's video player in the format selected on the website. This option can sometimes help when other download methods fail. Be aware that it uses more memory, which might cause issues with long or high-quality videos. The download process is similar to playing the video, with the playback position automatically jumping to the end of each loaded section. If your first attempt fails, try refreshing the page or restarting your browser and trying again. This sometimes resolves the issue. Important: the list of available download options depends on characteristics of the original video! E.g. initially posted 360p @30 fps video without sound cannot be downloaded in Full HD @60 fps with sound. Other features of the browser extension:
  • downloaded files have readable (human-friendly) names;
  • you can choose the button style: modern interface (appears on mouse over) and classic interface (appears on click);
  • "embedded" videos loading support, i.e. Odnoklassniki videos hosted on third-party sites;
  • screenshot button, i.e. you can save frames while watching videos;
  • thoughtful help section with answers to frequently asked questions;
  • several really useful settings :)
( ) In some cases, Odnoklassniki stores streams separately, therefore, to download video with sound they must be “glued” (muxing):
  • for small streams (up to 2 GB in total) the extension itself merges audio and video files, i.e. “on-the-fly” right in the browser;
  • for larger streams it is proposed to use IDL Client utility to avoid “freezing” of the browser tab.
( *) Odnoklassniki doesn't support MP3 format. So, to grab MP3 sound, the extension uses built-in audio converter for files up to 2 GB or suggests using IDL Client software otherwize.

firefox-addons:2588608.name: Soffid Password Manager
firefox-addons:2588608.summary: Enables Soffid self-service to start new remote applications
firefox-addons:2588608.description:
The aim of this addon is to inject user-names and password into selected applications, as part of our open-source identity governance and single sign on product. The sequence is as follows:
1. System administrator allows a users to use any application, and creates a user account for him/her. 
2. Soffid sync-server creates the account and assigns a random passwords
3. The user opens the self-service portal and clicks on the selected application icon.
4. She self service portal decrypts the password required to use the selected application and notifies the firefox addon to use them.
5. The firefox addon opens the selected application URL, and gets the script to inject the user name and password from the trusted URL https://www.soffid.com/ssokm/v1/script .
6. The firefox addon executes the downloaded script with the password sent by the self service portal.
Follow this link to install Soffid server side: http://confluence.soffid.org/display/SOF/Soffid+IAM+Installation

apple-itunes:1457937396.description:
Simple Notes is an easy-to-use notes app that leaves out the extras, so writing, organizing, and finding notes stay simple.
Notes go into color-coded folders, and you can find them using the calendar or photo album. No account or setup is required, and the app works offline.
Core features are free. Keep everything in one place, from class notes and work memos to a diary or baby journal.
[Features]
■ Add Photos to Notes
- Attach images to any note
- Insert pictures from your photo library, or take a photo on the spot
■ Folder Organization
- Create folders to keep your notes organized
- Choose from 24 folder colors to tell categories apart at a glance
■ Calendar View
- View notes by date using the built-in calendar
- Tap any date to see notes for that date — perfect for locating past entries
■ Photo Album
- Browse all images added to notes in one place
- Tap a photo to jump to its note
■ Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets
- Keep a note on your Home Screen like a sticky note — no need to open the app
- Lock Screen widgets let you see a note without unlocking your iPhone
- Choose which note to display and its text size
*Widgets are part of the Premium Service*
■ Sort Notes & Bullet Lists
- Sort by note date, date edited, date created, or title, ascending or descending
- Bullet lists make it easy to write shopping and packing lists
■ Passcode Lock
- Protect your notes with a passcode
- Supports Face ID and Touch ID for quick and secure access
■ Font Styles
- Choose from 12 font styles
- Choose a playful, elegant, or professional look for your notes
■ Themes and App Icons
- Pick from 23 theme colors and matching app icons
- Customize the look of the app and even the Home Screen icon
■ Full-Note Image & PDF
- Turn an entire note, even a long one with photos, into a single image to share
- Export notes as PDFs for work or school
■ Data Backup & Export
- Back up your notes to iCloud or export them to your computer
- Hand exported notes to AI apps for summaries, or save them to Notion or Google Drive
- Export formats: HTML (for Windows), RTFD (for Mac, keeps images), PDF, and TXT
*Data export and iCloud backup are part of the Premium Service; notes are also included in your iPhone’s device backup*
■ iCloud Sync
- Use iCloud to sync notes across your iPhone and iPad (Premium Service)
- Restore your notes on a new device if yours is lost or broken
■ Smart Search
- Use the built-in search to quickly find notes
- Add text tags like “#Important” to make key notes easier to locate
■ Character Count
- Check the character count as you write reports, essays, or fiction
- Each note can hold up to 100,000 characters
■ Text Display Settings
- Adjust text size, contrast, and line spacing
- Ideal if you prefer larger text or need better readability
- Dark Mode is supported for nighttime use
■ Remove Ads
- The Premium Service hides all ads
- Enjoy a clean, distraction-free screen for your notes
[Great For]
- Students: class and lecture notes with photos, one folder per course — export notes as PDF or text and hand them to AI apps for exam prep
- Parents: a baby journal with photos, growth records, and family memos in folders
- Work: meeting notes, ideas, and memos in one place — tap the mic on the iOS keyboard to dictate notes, handy for transcripts and meeting minutes
- Writers: novels, blog drafts, and reports — live character count and PDF sharing
[Good to Know]
- Works on iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 14 or later)
- Works offline — create and view notes even in Airplane Mode
- No handwriting inside notes or audio recording (write on exported images and PDFs)
[Help & Contact]
- For help, go to “Help / FAQ” in the app settings
- If you still have questions, tap “Contact Us” on the help screen
- For faster support, contact us through the app rather than leaving an App Store review

apple-itunes:6785545160.name: EFKey – Swipe & AI Keyboard
apple-itunes:6785545160.description:
EFKey types like the keyboard you already use. It has the parts that one is missing.
Typing runs on your phone, in 97 languages, and stays free.
GESTURES INSTEAD OF PAGES
Hold any key and its second character comes up. @ # % € sit in the corner of every key, so the numbers page stays where it is.
Flick left on the delete key and it erases whole words.
Hold the spacebar and the keyboard turns into a trackpad. Slide, and the cursor lands where you meant it.
Glide over the letters and the word types itself, accents and apostrophes included.
Double-space ends the sentence.
97 LANGUAGES, THREE AT A TIME
Turn on up to three languages and write in all of them in one sentence: dakujem becomes ďakujem while dont gets its apostrophe. Nothing to switch.
26 languages are fully verified. 71 more are in beta: they work, a native speaker just hasn't checked them yet. New in 2.3: Latin American Spanish, Indian English, Canadian French, Swiss German, Thai, Burmese and Arabizi.
The app itself speaks 26 languages.
QWERTY, QWERTZ, AZERTY, Dvorak, Colemak.
A number row that adds a row instead of shrinking your keys.
CORRECTION THAT READS THE SENTENCE
Autocorrect looks at up to three words of context. "i said hat" becomes "that"; "red hat" stays as it is.
It fixes a word with three mistakes in it and leaves alone the one that was already right.
Type germany or iphone and get Germany and iPhone.
Names from your contacts show up in suggestions and in swipe. No contacts permission needed.
Prediction learns how you write. Give it a few days.
Fix a word once and press backspace: it never touches that word again.
THE TOOLS. EFKEY PRO.
Clipboard history with your own categories, pinning and search. Synced with your Mac, end-to-end encrypted, through the free EFClip app.
Translator. Type in one language, insert the other, without leaving the keyboard.
Dictation. Speak and it types, translated if you want, with a Live Activity in the Dynamic Island.
AI edits. Rewrite, fix the grammar, change the tone. Or swipe down from the spacebar and the whole field gets rewritten.
GIF search, a calculator that answers in the suggestion bar, text shortcuts, My info autofill, one-handed mode, typing stats.
Shortcuts on the keys: hold C to copy, H for clipboard history, D for dictation. Remappable.
Your own colors and saved themes, key press animations, more swipe trail effects.
iCloud sync of learned words and settings.
One purchase. No subscription. Seven days free when you start the trial yourself, no card and no account. Typing stays free either way.
Translation, dictation and AI edits run on-device where iOS supports it. Or bring your own API key (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter). It stays in your Keychain, and your text goes only to the provider you picked.
MADE TO FEEL RIGHT
Native down to the pixel, light and dark, and it follows the appearance of the app you are in.
Emoji with search, skin tones and suggestions as you type.
Settings you can search. Type a word and it takes you to the switch.
On iPad and iPhone Duo: split, or keys on one half and a touchpad on the other.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No keystroke logging. No analytics or tracking SDKs. No server of mine anywhere.
Typing, prediction and autocorrect work offline. In a password shown as plain text, EFKey stops correcting and learns nothing.
The only things that leave your phone are the ones you switch on yourself: GIF search, your own AI key, iCloud sync (learned words end-to-end encrypted, settings through your private iCloud). efkey.app/privacy says what, where and when.
Full Access is optional. The keyboard types at full strength without it. Only the tools that reach outside the keyboard need it.
Incognito in the toolbar: nothing learned, nothing kept in clipboard history.
Your learned and blocked words export and import anytime.
LIGHT ON STORAGE
Every language except English downloads when you enable it.
Set it up in a minute.
Questions? dev@eef.sk · efkey.app
